sourceFile: 48. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test Dry normal F-pcb sub3 - R  2026.01.02. -_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because the changed factor and function comparisons are mis-grouped despite citeable source context.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly mixes lines, test durations, and an unexplained condition 3.
Line L function comparison uses the Line R normal row instead of the Line L normal row.
Function comparison rows omit the Line L normal evidence row.
Measurement outcome is an invalid aggregation of defect columns, not a measurement result.
Evidence includes rows not shown in provided context, limiting verification.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to dry oven 105±5°C versus normal IR dry 300±5°C/10min.
Keep Line R and Line L as subgroup keys for function results.
Recalculate Line L against its own normal row and include that citation.
Treat F-PCB separate as a process-defect duration check, not a normal-versus-test comparison unless a baseline exists.
Remove the measurement outcome unless real measurement/spec rows are provided.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partly sufficient, but missing/incorrect key rows prevent final evidence use.
